units.source_text: 源氏公子也并非魂梦颠倒地强欲求爱。

en.t: Prince Genji was not so utterly infatuated that he was blindly forcing his love upon her.

units.source_text: 只因槿姬的冷淡出乎意外，教他就此罢休，终不甘心。

en.t: It was only because Princess Asagao's coldness was so unexpected that he could not bring himself to give up then and there.

units.source_text: 况且他的人品与威望异常优越，对世情物理无不精通，

en.t: Moreover, his character and prestige were exceptionally distinguished, and he understood every aspect of worldly affairs and human reason.

units.source_text: 对人情冷暖积有经验，自己也觉得比从前阅世更深了。

en.t: He had gained experience of both warmth and coldness in human feeling, and he himself felt that he knew the world more deeply than before.

units.source_text: 如今到了这年龄，还要东钻西营地求爱，已经应该顾忌世间诽议了。

en.t: At his present age, if he still went scheming here and there in pursuit of love, he really ought to worry about public criticism.

units.source_text: 然而若再空无所得，岂不更被世人当作笑话？

en.t: Yet if he gained nothing once again, would he not become even more of a laughingstock to the world?

units.source_text: 他心绪混乱，不知如何是好，多天不曾回二条院宿夜。

en.t: His mind was in confusion, and not knowing what to do, he did not return to spend the night at Nijo Palace for many days.

units.source_text: 因此紫姬便如古歌所咏：“暂别心如焚，方知戏不得。”

en.t: Because of this, Lady Murasaki felt as the old poem says: only when a brief parting sets the heart aflame does one learn that love is no game.

units.source_text: 她竭力忍耐，然而有时禁不住流出眼泪来。

en.t: She tried her utmost to endure it, but at times she could not keep tears from falling.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“你的神色和往常不同，是什么道理？

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "Your expression is different from usual. What is the reason?

units.source_text: 教我想不通了。”

en.t: It leaves me quite unable to understand."

units.source_text: 他伸手抚摸她的头发，着意温存。

en.t: He reached out and stroked her hair, deliberately showing her tenderness.

units.source_text: 这一对恩爱夫妻的姿态，真是画也画不出来。

en.t: The sight of this loving couple was truly beyond anything a painting could capture.

units.source_text: 源氏公子又说：“母后弃养之后，皇上一直悲伤愁叹，我看他十分可怜。

en.t: Prince Genji went on, "Since the Empress Mother's passing, His Majesty has been grieving and sighing without cease, and I find him deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 加之太政大臣逝世，代理乏人，而政务纷繁，我不得不常居宫中，

en.t: In addition, the Grand Minister has died, there is no suitable deputy, and affairs of state are so numerous that I have had to stay constantly at court.

units.source_text: 因此好几天没有回家。

en.t: For that reason I have not come home for several days.

units.source_text: 你觉得不惯，怨恨我，也自难怪。

en.t: It is only natural that you are unused to this and resent me.

units.source_text: 但现在我决不像从前那样浮薄了，你可放心。

en.t: But now I am certainly no longer as frivolous as I once was, so you may be at ease.

units.source_text: 你虽然已是大人，但是还像小孩一样不能体谅人，不能了解我的心情，真是遗憾！”

en.t: Although you are already grown, you still cannot sympathize with others or understand my feelings, like a child. It truly saddens me!"

units.source_text: 一面说着，一面替她整理额发。

en.t: As he spoke, he arranged the hair at her forehead for her.

units.source_text: 紫姬越发撒娇了，背转了头，一直默不作声。

en.t: Lady Murasaki became even more petulantly affectionate, turned her head away, and remained silent.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“你这种孩子脾气，不知道是谁养成你的。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Who could have raised you to have such a childish temper?"

units.source_text: 心中却想道：“世事无常，人寿几何！

en.t: Yet in his heart he thought, "The world is impermanent, and how long is a human life?

units.source_text: 连这个人也和我两条心肠，真教我伤心呵！”

en.t: Even this person has a heart divided from mine. How deeply it grieves me!"

units.source_text: 左思右想，闷闷不乐良久。

en.t: He turned the matter over and over in his mind and remained gloomy for a long while.

units.source_text: 后来又对她说：“近来我对槿姬偶有交往，大约你又在疑心我了。

en.t: Later he said to her again, "Lately I have had occasional dealings with Princess Asagao, and you are probably suspecting me again.

units.source_text: 这全是瞎猜，不久你自会明白真相。

en.t: That is all groundless guesswork; before long you will understand the truth for yourself.

units.source_text: 此人脾气向来孤僻，不喜交游。

en.t: Her nature has always been solitary, and she does not enjoy social intercourse.

units.source_text: 我只是在寂寞无聊之时，偶尔写封信去和她开开玩笑，教她懊恼一下而已。

en.t: When I am lonely and bored, I merely send her an occasional letter to tease her and make her a little vexed.

units.source_text: 她在家里空闲无事，有时也难得复我一信。

en.t: When she is idle at home with nothing to do, she sometimes, rarely enough, sends me a reply.

units.source_text: 并不是认真的恋爱，所以没有什么事实值得向你讲。

en.t: It is not a serious love affair, so there is nothing real worth telling you about.

units.source_text: 你应该想转来，切勿为此事懊恼。”

en.t: You should think better of it and must not distress yourself over this matter."

units.source_text: 这一天他镇日在家抚慰她。

en.t: That day he stayed at home all day comforting her.
